note: What a server sends to play a sound once. The header carries zero.

fields.name: sound
fields.note: The sound event's name. The text ends at its first zero byte, which falls within the field.

fields.name: owner
fields.note: The object to play it at, where a client knows one by this id; otherwise, or for zero, the sound has no place.
